    <div class="about-text">
      <h2>About Me</h2>
        <p>Despite the space-themed landing, this is not an astronomy website. It marks one of the happiest milestones of my career: defending my doctoral research in front of family and close friends, and receiving my PhD in Health Sciences.
        I started out in Biomedical Sciences, where I fell for immunology in the lab. Somewhere along the way I also fell for code, and the two collided in a master's at their intersection, and then in a PhD. My doctoral work focused on building artificial intelligence methods to study epitopes—small protein fragments that cells present on MHC molecules, essentially a molecular "here is what is going on inside me" signal to the immune system. Reading that signal well is key to designing better vaccines, both against infectious diseases and cancer.</p>
        <p>When I step away from the desk, I am usually moving. Running comes first, whether that is fast city kilometres or longer, quieter trails when I need to reset. Close behind is <a href="arluxis.html">ARLUXIS.</a>—my own photography brand—where I channel a more creative side of me and document wherever I go with my camera. Beyond that, I hike and camp whenever I can, and when I do finally sit still, it is usually with a good book in hand, often a space opera.</p>
        <p>Welcome to my site. If you would like to connect, talk science, or swap trail recommendations, feel free to reach out.</p>
    </div>

<!-- All scripts -->
  <!-- toggle abstract -->
  <script>
  function toggleAbstract(element) {
    // Select the clicked abstract
    const abstract = element.closest('.publication-item').querySelector('.abstract');

    // Close all other abstracts
    document.querySelectorAll('.abstract').forEach(item => {
      if (item !== abstract) item.style.display = 'none';
    });

    // Toggle the clicked abstract
    abstract.style.display = abstract.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
  }
  </script>
  <!-- navigation headers -->
  <script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Get all the navigation links in the navbar
    var navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-links a');
    var menuToggle = document.getElementById('menu-toggle');

    // Add click event listeners to navbar links only
    navLinks.forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', function(event) {
        // Prevent default anchor behavior
        event.preventDefault();

        // Check if the link is the "Home" button
        if (this.getAttribute('id') === 'homeButton') {
          // Scroll to the top smoothly
          window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
        } else {
          // For other links, scroll to the target section
          var targetId = this.getAttribute('href').substring(1);
          var targetElement = document.getElementById(targetId);

          // Calculate the scroll position, accounting for the navbar height
          var navbarHeight = document.querySelector('.navbar').offsetHeight;
          var targetPosition = targetElement.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - navbarHeight;

          // Smoothly scroll to the target position
          window.scrollTo({ top: targetPosition, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }

        // Uncheck the menu toggle checkbox to close the menu
        menuToggle.checked = false;
      });
    });
  });
  </script>

  <!-- add new tag -->
  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      let today = new Date();
      let newThreshold = 200; // Days to consider an item as new
      let publications = document.querySelectorAll(".publication-item");

      publications.forEach((pub) => {
        let yearData = pub.getAttribute("data-year");

        if (yearData) {
          // Handle both "YYYY-MM" and "YYYY" formats
          let pubDate = null;
          if (yearData.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/)) {
            pubDate = new Date(`${yearData}-01`);
          } else if (yearData.match(/^\d{4}$/)) {
            pubDate = new Date(`${yearData}-01-01`);
          }

          if (pubDate) {
            let diffDays = (today - pubDate) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);

            if (diffDays <= newThreshold) {
              let newTag = document.createElement("span");
              newTag.classList.add("new-tag");
              newTag.textContent = "New";

              let title = pub.querySelector(".publication-title");
              if (title && !title.querySelector(".new-tag")) {
                title.appendChild(newTag);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      });
    });
  </script>


  <!-- order manuscripts -->
  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const container = document.querySelector(".publications-section .max-widht");

      if (!container) return;

      const items = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll(".publication-item"));

      items.sort((a, b) => {
        const aFirst = a.dataset.firstAuthor === "true" ? 0 : 1;
        const bFirst = b.dataset.firstAuthor === "true" ? 0 : 1;

        // Sort first by first-authorship, then by date (descending)
        if (aFirst !== bFirst) {
          return aFirst - bFirst;
        } else {
          return b.dataset.year.localeCompare(a.dataset.year);
        }
      });

      // Remove existing items (and dividers)
      items.forEach(item => {
        const divider = item.nextElementSibling;
        if (divider && divider.classList.contains("divider")) {
          divider.remove();
        }
        item.remove();
      });

      // Append sorted items and new dividers
      items.forEach((item, index) => {
        container.appendChild(item);
        if (index < items.length - 1) {
          const divider = document.createElement("div");
          divider.classList.add("divider");
          container.appendChild(divider);
        }
      });
    });
  </script>
  <!--change color of divider -->
  <script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const publications = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".publication-item"));

    // Find the last first-author publication
    let lastFirstAuthorIndex = -1;
    publications.forEach((pub, index) => {
      if (pub.dataset.firstAuthor === "true") {
        lastFirstAuthorIndex = index;
      }
    });

    // If we found at least one first-author publication and there's a divider after it
    if (lastFirstAuthorIndex !== -1 && lastFirstAuthorIndex < publications.length - 1) {
      const lastFirstAuthor = publications[lastFirstAuthorIndex];
      const divider = lastFirstAuthor.nextElementSibling;

      if (divider && divider.classList.contains("divider")) {
        // Change the divider color
        divider.style.backgroundColor = "#c9933a";
        divider.style.height = "1px"; // Optional: make it a bit thicker
      }
    }
  });
</script>
